about: NailsRecs starter catalog (2026-10-24): current nail polish lines, gel polish and builder gel systems, base and top coats, press-on nails, nail strengthening treatments and cuticle oils. Every entry was read on 2026-10-24 from the maker's own page linked in sources (OPI, Essie, Sally Hansen, Holo Taco, Cirque Colors, Mooncat, Dazzle Dry, Olive & June, ORLY, Static Nails, Glamnetic, KISS, CND, Deborah Lippmann, Cuccio, Kokoist, Nailboo, Mylee, Nails.INC, Manucurist, Seche, Aprés, and ILNP added 2026-10-25); type and key specs are what the page says (air dry or LED/UV lamp, no-wipe, peel-off), size only where the page states one size, anything else blank. One entry per formula or line as the maker names it: shades, finishes, tints, lengths and shapes of one formula are one entry (OPI Nail Lacquer covers every Nail Lacquer shade, OPI Nail Envy covers its tinted versions, Glamnetic Press-On Nails covers every design), but a different formula is a different entry (OPI Nail Lacquer vs Infinite Shine vs GelColor vs GELement, Essie Nail Polish vs Gel Couture vs Expressie, Sally Hansen Hard as Nails vs Advanced Hard as Nails, CND Shellac vs Vinylux). Shade names are never product names. Not in it yet: Zoya, DND, Gelish, Beetles, Le Mini Macaron and Bio Seaweed Gel (sites not readable or not read in this pass), dip powders other than Nailboo's, acrylic systems, tools, lamps, removers and hand care. Columns: shape = category, balance = type, surface = key specs (cure and finish), core = formula as the page states it, weight = size as the page states it. No model years.
